item.title: Fatal Rejection Murder Trial: Defense’s Closing Argument
item.description: Waymore Gerhardt's defense present their closing argument. Gerhardt, now 22, is charged with first-degree murder in the death of Demiah Appling. Gerhardt allegedly shot Appling with a .22 long rifle, and buried her in a shallow grave. (2/13/26)

item.title: Fatal Rejection Murder Trial: Watch the Verdict!
item.description: After less than an hour of deliberations, the jury reaches a verdict in Waymore Gerhardt's trial where he is charged with first-degree murder and tampering with evidence in the death of Demiah Appling. (2/13/26)

item.title: Au Pair Juliana Magalhães Sentenced for Joseph Ryan’s Death
item.description: Juliana Magalhães, a former au pair for the Banfield family, is sentenced for the death of Joseph Ryan. after pleading guilty to manslaughter. Magalhães was having an affair with convicted double murderer Brendan Banfield. (2/13/26)
